verdict: Ciena's revenue surged 37% to a record $1,671M as AI-driven network spending lifted optical sales 46%, and profit jumped more than fivefold to $266M.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: $1,671M vs $1,219M a year ago — a record quarter

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP)
kpis.note: diluted, vs $0.35 a year ago; adjusted EPS was $2.11

kpis.label: FY26 revenue guidance
kpis.note: raised — about +35% for the full fiscal year at the midpoint

segments.name: Optical Networking
segments.note: Optical systems that move data over fiber — Ciena's core, and the direct beneficiary of AI data-center building. Up 46%.

segments.name: Routing and Switching
segments.note: Equipment that directs data traffic within and between networks. Up 30%.

segments.name: Platform Software and Services
segments.note: Software that runs and manages the networks Ciena sells. Up 10%.

segments.name: Blue Planet
segments.note: Automation software that helps network operators plan and run services. Down 17%.

segments.name: Global Services
segments.note: Maintenance, support, installation and advisory services for customers' networks. Up 21%.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Building the optical and routing products and software — the biggest running cost.

opex.name: Sales & marketing
opex.note: Selling to telecom carriers, cloud providers and other network operators.

opex.name: General & administrative and other
opex.note: Running the company ($63M of G&A), plus $4M of amortization of acquired intangibles and $1M of impairments and restructuring — combined here so the rounded lines foot.

otherDetail: Other income, net was $9M: $22M of interest and other income, less $6M of interest expense and a $7M loss on extinguishing and modifying debt.
oneTimers: The quarter includes a $7M loss on extinguishing and modifying debt, booked below operating profit, and $1M of significant asset impairments and restructuring costs inside operating expenses. Adjusted (non-GAAP) EPS was $2.11 vs $1.83 GAAP.
footerNote: Ciena's fiscal year ends on the Saturday nearest October 31, so this is its fiscal Q3 2026, ended August 1, 2026. Figures are rounded to $M from the reported thousands.

takeaways.title: AI networks are the story
takeaways.text: Revenue hit a record $1,671M, up 37%. Optical Networking alone was $1,191M — 71% of revenue — up 46%, as AI keeps driving compounding waves of network investment by carriers and cloud providers. Two customers each accounted for more than 10% of revenue, 41.7% combined.

takeaways.title: Profit grew much faster than sales
takeaways.text: Net income rose to $266M from $50M a year ago. Gross margin widened to 45.4% from 41.3% while operating expenses grew only 7% to $458M, so operating margin expanded to 18.0% from 6.1% — classic operating leverage.

takeaways.title: Guidance raised again
takeaways.text: Ciena guided fiscal Q4 revenue to $1.75B plus or minus $50M and raised full-year fiscal 2026 revenue guidance to $6.42B plus or minus $50M — about 35% growth at the midpoint. It also bought back about 0.4M shares for $172M in the quarter.
